description: Every knowledge arm starts from this pool, in this order. A lesson named by a task's `lessons` is the knowledge that task needs; the rest are distractors a real knowledge base would also hold. `supersedes` names an earlier lesson in this file that the lesson replaces.

lessons.title: Ledger balances come from /v1/balances as decimal strings
lessons.content: Read wallet balances from the ledger service with GET /v1/balances?accounts=<ids>. Each row has `available` as a decimal string such as "12.34"; convert it to integer cents with Math.round(Number(value) * 100) before doing arithmetic.

lessons.title: Never send payment POSTs through fetchJson; use sendOnce
lessons.content: fetchJson in the payments service's src/http.js retries on ETIMEDOUT. The gateway sometimes times out after it has already processed a POST, so a retried capture charged a customer twice (ticket #8812). Rule: never send a non-idempotent request (POST/PUT: captures, refunds, payouts) through fetchJson. Use sendOnce from src/http.js, which makes exactly one attempt; surface the timeout to the caller instead of retrying.

lessons.title: Staging Postgres moved to db-staging-2.internal:6432
lessons.content: db-staging-1.internal was decommissioned on 2026-09-02. Staging Postgres is now only reachable through pgbouncer at db-staging-2.internal:6432; the database name is unchanged. config/environments.json in the app repos still lists the old host because it is generated from the infra repo and the regeneration job is blocked, so do not hand-edit it. Scripts that target staging must override the host and port themselves.

lessons.title: Every API error code needs a row in docs/error-codes.md
lessons.content: API error codes are a public contract. The developer-portal build in the platform repo parses docs/error-codes.md from every API repo and fails the release when src/errors.js defines a code the table does not list; nothing in the API repo's own CI catches it (release 4.12 was blocked this way). Add the table row (code, HTTP status, client action) in the same change that adds the code.

lessons.title: Format dates with formatIsoDate; legacy formatDate is frozen
lessons.content: Decision 2026-08-14 (billing): formatDate in src/vendor/legacy-dates.js formats in the server's local time zone, and APAC servers run in local time, so New Zealand customers saw dates one day late. All new date formatting uses formatIsoDate from src/lib/dates.js, which formats the UTC calendar day. legacy-dates.js is frozen: add no new call sites, and migrate old ones as they are touched.

lessons.title: Ledger balances: use /v2/accounts/<id>/balance; /v1/balances is stale
lessons.content: As of 2026-09-15 GET /v1/balances is deprecated. It still answers, but for accounts already migrated to the new ledger it returns a stale snapshot. Use GET /v2/accounts/<id>/balance, which returns { accountId, availableCents } with integer cents, so no decimal conversion is needed. This replaces the earlier guidance to read /v1/balances and convert the decimal string.

lessons.title: Redis cache keys must start with the tenant id
lessons.content: Every Redis key in the shop services starts with `t:<tenantId>:`. A key without the prefix leaked one tenant's cart totals to another during the 2026-05 cache incident. The cache helper enforces it at runtime only in staging, so reviewers check it by hand.

lessons.title: Never log full card numbers or gateway payloads
lessons.content: Payment handlers log only the last four digits of a card and the gateway's request id. Logging a raw gateway payload put PANs into the log pipeline in 2026-03 and triggered a PCI review. Use redactPayment() from the logging package before any log call that touches a gateway response.

lessons.title: Build deploy images with --platform linux/amd64
lessons.content: Images built on Apple Silicon default to arm64 and crash-loop on the amd64 deploy cluster with `exec format error`. Always build deploy images with `docker build --platform linux/amd64`; the release script does this, ad hoc builds must too.

lessons.title: Feature flags expire 90 days after creation
lessons.content: The flag service deletes flags 90 days after creation and the SDK then returns the default value. Before a flag nears expiry, either remove it from code or renew it in the flag console; an expired checkout flag silently disabled express checkout in 2026-06.

lessons.title: Analytics events queries must filter on event_date
lessons.content: The analytics `events` table is partitioned by event_date. A query without an event_date predicate scans every partition and costs hundreds of dollars; the warehouse rejects such queries in scheduled jobs but not in notebooks.

lessons.title: Staging is reseeded nightly at 02:00 UTC
lessons.content: Staging data is wiped and reseeded every night at 02:00 UTC. Manual test accounts created during the day disappear; long-lived test accounts belong in the seed fixtures in the infra repo.

lessons.title: Postgres migrations must set a lock_timeout
lessons.content: Every schema migration starts with `SET lock_timeout = '5s'`. An ALTER TABLE on orders without it queued behind a long transaction and blocked all checkout writes for four minutes in 2026-04.

lessons.title: List endpoints paginate with opaque cursors, not offsets
lessons.content: Decision 2026-02: new list endpoints return { items, nextCursor } and accept ?cursor=. Offset pagination is not allowed in new endpoints because offsets skip and repeat rows while orders are being inserted.

lessons.title: Store money as integer minor units with a currency code
lessons.content: Money is stored and passed as integer minor units plus an ISO 4217 currency code. JPY has zero decimal places and BHD has three, so never assume two decimals when converting for display; use the currency formatter.

lessons.title: Services run Node 22 LTS; do not use Node 24-only APIs
lessons.content: Production and CI images run Node 22 LTS. Code that relies on Node 24-only APIs passes on developer laptops and fails in CI; check the API's 'Added in' version before using it.

lessons.title: Verify gateway webhook signatures against the raw body
lessons.content: Gateway webhook signatures are computed over the raw request bytes. Verifying against a re-serialized JSON body fails intermittently because key order and whitespace differ; read the raw body before any JSON middleware.

lessons.title: Error tracking samples 10% of 4xx events
lessons.content: The error tracker keeps every 5xx event but samples 4xx events at 10%. A rise in client errors therefore looks ten times smaller in the tracker than in the API gateway's own metrics; use the gateway dashboard for 4xx rates.
